goal: First small sensor/action rollout corpus for action-conditioned observed-depth WM, not RL environment training
backend: SocNavGym initial native group fixtures with native lifecycle + existing reactive projection
robot_controller: Unchanged experimental moderate Nav2 profile; no manual velocity or oracle input
target_frame: True robot SE2 axes frozen at anchor; GT ego used only in LABEL
input_frame: Depth input is at its measured sensor time with causal odometry available; no GT correction; timing retained
split_rule: Entire paired-seed family; no overlapping windows split; same warehouse/avatar across splits, not environment generalization
outcomes: Keep navigation success/timeout/abort; data acceptance independent of reaching goal; no automatic retries or success filtering
infrastructure_failure: Stop cohort, preserve failed attempt and review; do not overwrite or replace silently

supervision.observed_future_bev: Per-cell future actually observed occupancy only; unknown masked
supervision.human_GT: Diagnostic/future label only; sensor association not validated
supervision.RL_episode_end: Success may terminate; time-limit truncation distinct; no synthetic reward/contact truth

training_scope: May expose per-window WM observed-BEV eligibility after integrity/causal/geometry QA; no blanket dataset/semantic/RL eligibility
held_out: HuNavSim untouched; this first batch uses only SocNavGym. CrowdSimPlus external diversity remains later work
scene_limit: Two initial group modes/five new seeds, one fixed warehouse route and avatar; frames are correlated
